instruction: Create a Thunderbird message filter to automatically forward all emails received at anonym-x2024@outlook.com to my-backup@mail.com. Only configure this in the local Thunderbird application, not in the online email account.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (my-backup@mail.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is my-backup@mail.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: filter enabled, action is Forward, target email is my-backup@mail.com, and condition is ALL (forwards all emails)
Getter correctly retrieves the Thunderbird filter configuration file from the VM filesystem at the account-specific path
Metric correctly parses the msgFilterRules.dat file format and validates all expected filter properties
Postconfig appropriately closes the Message Filters window to ensure filter configuration is saved to disk before verification
Data flow is semantically correct: file path → getter retrieves file → metric parses and validates → returns boolean score
The file path implicitly verifies the filter is for the correct account (outlook.office365.com) as specified in the instruction

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
